page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 248 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per core. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz and includes a large 504 MB L3 cache. For local storage, the instance bundles 1745 GB of NVMe SSD capacity across five local drives, though it does not include any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across several compute and memory metrics. The instance achieves top-tier status in single-threaded tasks, including a Geekbench single-core score of 2307.0 and high-speed gzip compression at 36.83 GB/sec. Multi-threaded performance is also robust, demonstrated by a Passmark CPU score of 53228.41 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18257.0. Memory subsystem testing shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2702.38 GB/sec and a Passmark memory score of 2796.01. For database operations, the server handles 62.26 million Redis SET operations per second, while static web serving throughput reaches 59.7 GB/sec.

The combination of high memory density, dedicated CPU allocation, and fast local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring rapid data access without the overhead of network-attached storage. It is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, caching layers, and data processing pipelines. Additionally, the CPU support for Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions enables efficient execution of localized machine learning tasks, such as small-model LLM inference, where it achieves 362.23 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model.
